About the project brief

When you submit the enquiry form, your business name, name, email address, optional phone number, project details, concept preference and investment acknowledgement are sent through FormSubmit to meridiusai.agency@gmail.com. We use these details to discuss your enquiry. Please do not include passwords, payment details or other sensitive information. FormSubmit processes submissions and provides spam protection; its own privacy practices apply.

About the concept sites

The eight sample businesses are fictional design previews. Their enquiry forms demonstrate an interaction and do not send messages or make reservations.

Site resources

Images and application code are served with the website. Fonts may be requested from Google Fonts. The hosting provider may process standard request information to deliver the website.

Questions about your information

For questions or requests to correct or delete enquiry information held by Meridius AI, email meridiusai.agency@gmail.com. See FormSubmit’s privacy policy for information about its service.
